body.x: RADIO GEARS(CEO Park Se-Geun, radiogears.com), an exhibit support company of Daegu Mobile Convergence Center, will participate in ‘2013 International Consumer Electronics Show(hear after ‘CES 2013’) held at US, Las Vegas, from Jan.8, 2013 to Jan.11 and introduce integrated combo IPTV STB.

The integrated combo IPTV STB of RADIO GEARS help you directly watch real time or recorded drama, movies or video through TV, without PC. And it added IPTV functionality and application to the existing media player functionality and widened scalability. When connecting this product to the existing TV, you can enjoy the multi-box form including live TV, movies, music and communication.

Also, it has Android OS-based social network and Web search and E-mail transmitter/Receiver and provides contents to fit people’s tastes and purposes such as sport, entertainments and group and something interesting to watch through association with the site.

It will make a customer’s server be shared with other customers to offer rich content. Through associating with content providers and network operators, it will provide platform to realize a profit sharing.

In addition, it will help special customers such as Hotel·Hospital·Video shop, etc. required server and provide IPTV related One-stop service as total solution including operating SW, STB terminal unit.

IPTV STB of RADIO GEARS is getting good response from overseas, including US, Europe, Japan, Australia and Thailand and RADIO GEARS plans to launch a tiny pocket set-top box product considering the portability. In the next year, it will mainly export the products to Asia and America market. As being the forefront of the middleware dissemination, it is expected to continue to increase market share in the World market.

‘CES 2013’ is the world’s largest electronics exhibition hosted by home appliances Manufacturers Association(CEA) whose members are about 600 consumer electronics industry companies of US. In the exhibition, will be introduced all kinds of consumer products such as home network•Mobile•MP3 as well as Audio•Video•Car Audio•Hardware•Software•Satellite receiver•Telephone.

Meanwhile, Daegu Mobile Convergence Center will help 9 domestic mobile IT convergence companies booth lease and facility devices, counseling and interpretation, production shipping, product directory book, as part of national project ‘New Industry Mobile Convergence global competitiveness reinforcement.
